text:
maria: Quick async check — what I did: prewarmed AMS/gpu-pool-3 with `./scripts/prewarm.sh --pool gpu-pool-3 --hours 4`, confirmed nv8a autoscaler config. Blockers: GCP quota for asia-southeast1 GPUs still at 120, we need +40 for next week. Today: open ticket + coordinate canary drain.
aj: Thanks — what case number for quota? I'll follow up with the account team.
samir: Filed support case 1234567890 with GCP yesterday, linked to billing account Redwood-Prod-AMS. Also opened internal PR to bump pool label -> `env: "dedicated"` (PR #412). Pending review.
linda: Observed spot eviction spike in sin-1 last night ~6% avg across gpu-spot-preempt. Ops alert triggered at ~02:12 UTC. Suggest moving critical queues to reserved capacity until eviction normalizes.
ops-bot: [automated] eviction-rate(sin-1)=6.2% over 1h; threshold=3.0%; affected_pools=[gpu-spot-preempt]; pager: @linda @maria
natalie: @samir can you add the PR to the canary rollout doc? Need to sync on rollback policy. Also, do we have a terraform plan artifact for the bump?
samir: Plan uploaded to CI: https://ci.redwood/plan/5653 — contains `resource "google_compute_region_disk" "gpu" { ... }`. Will add the doc and link the runbook.
kevin: I can take the canary drain tonight 23:00 UTC. @aj can you +1 the runbook? I'll leave a note in #eng-oncall with the window.
aj: +1 runbook looks good. Quick reminder: make sure `kubectl drain` uses `--ignore-daemonsets` and `--delete-local-data` for the canary, and run with `--grace-period=120`.
maria: Thanks — action items: samir follow up on PR & plan, aj follow up with TAM for quota bump, kevin will run canary, linda to monitor sin-1 eviction. I'll update the provisioning sheet and tag the regions.
linda: I'll also spin up a 24h reserved buffer in sin-1 (temporary) — will post cost estimate and the cost center tag.
kevin: Small note: if eviction persists we should consider fallback region ap-south1 for non-latency-critical batch workloads; I'll add a quick playbook.
maria: Closing loop — will post a short status update by 18:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
